thread:
raj: Quick ask — planning a canary rollback of redwood-phi-7b tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Can we secure 4x H100s in us-west1 for a 2h quiet window (09:00-11:00)? Also pinging for PR #4521 lgtm and a brief smoke test. @maria @anna

maria: On it. I can peek quotas now. Last night dev pool showed 2x free H100 slots only. If we need 4x we'll likely need vendor hold or to preempt a noncritical demo slot.

anna: FYI I can delay the demo reservation that overlaps 09:30-10:30 if that helps. Will confirm with the demo owner.

kevin: If vendor can hold, what's the TTL we should request? vendor holds often accept a 2-hr hold but want exact start time.

raj: Start 09:00 UTC, TTL 2h, and request soft preemption policy (notify 10m before). We'll be doing small traffic canary (10% of traffic) then immediate rollback if latency regresses.

maria: Reached out to vendor-liaison-bot with this payload: ```json
{
  "region": "us-west1",
  "sku": "H100",
  "count": 4,
  "start": "2026-03-24T09:00:00Z",
  "duration_hours": 2,
  "hold_type": "soft",
  "notify_minutes": 10
}
```

vendor-liaison-bot: vendor contact acknowledged. ETA for confirm: 45m. Tentative hold accepted pending PO approval.

raj: Thanks. Two small asks: 1) maria, can you post terraform snippet we should use to spin up the canary infra so infra-oncall can review earlier? 2) anna please confirm demo can be bumped.

maria: Paste below minimal TF for the canary pool — uses our internal module. Tweak as needed: ```hcl
module "canary_pool" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/internal-gpu-pools.git//modules/pool"
  name   = "phi-rollback-canary"
  region = "us-west1"
  gpu    = "h100"
  count  = 4
  preemption_policy = "soft"
  labels = {owner = "rollback-phi"}
}
```

maria: Also checked quotas: project infra-dev has 6 free H100s in us-west1 if we immediately release two demo slots. If vendor hold is delayed we'll still be able to run but will need to coordinate demo bump (anna).

anna: Confirmed — I pinged demo-owner (sam). Sam ok to shift to later slot; releasing 2 demo H100s now.

kevin: Finance note — vendor mentioned PO required for long holds >4h; for 2h soft hold shouldn't need extra approval but invoice will be attached to demo/infra charge codes.

raj: Great. If vendor-liaison-bot confirms hold, I'll merge PR #4521 (small rollback flag) and kick canary infra TF apply 30m before start.

vendor-liaison-bot: Hold confirmed. Vendor will reserve 4x H100 from 2026-03-24T09:00:00Z to 2026-03-24T11:00:00Z. PO not required. Notification will be sent 10 minutes before end.

kevin: Noted. Oncall: please be ready for smoke tests at 09:05 UTC, simple prompt latency check against baseline.

raj: Thanks all. I'll post a brief runbook in #eng-oncall and tag the list. PR #4521 ready once I merge. :thumbsup:

anna: LGTM, thanks for coordinating.

kevin: Thanks — marking this thread resolved for capacity.

raj: closing loop — vendor hold confirmed, TF snippet posted, demo slots released. Will update after canary completes. :white_check_mark:
